records.name: Landijs
records.facts_used: Latvijas Vēstnesis No. 151, 23 Oct 2001, “Likvidācijas, bankroti”: SIA “1.V.A.” (Ķekava parish), “Ieceltas: Danilevičs Landijs … likvidators” (scan visually checked). LV-SILINS90 PDF p. 210 / printed p. 207: “Land/is, -ijs, vc. Land 'zeme' MG 324 (?); — Rolands vai fnd. (?); V 20. gs. 1c.” (text layer read).
records.reason: Exact-spelling dated use plus the dictionary’s questioned suggestions; the reviewed text states the origin as unsettled.
records.uncertainties: Origin unresolved; the 2001 bearer is a private person and is not named in the widget.
records.next_steps: Replaces the round 16 displayed hypothesis; keep the origin open if a naming study appears.

records.name: Landa

records.reason: No new evidence beyond the dictionary.
records.uncertainties: Periodika route unusable for this spelling.
records.next_steps: Closed for Periodika; only a signed naming study could resolve the Jolanda link.

records.name: Gerdvilė
records.facts_used: Salys 1983 PDF p. 231 lists Gerdvilė as a feminine name (rechecked in cache). vardai.vlkk.lt still behind the bot check; not bypassed.
records.uncertainties: Explanation of gerd-/vil- for this exact name still missing.
records.next_steps: Needs a human browser visit to vardai.vlkk.lt/vardas/Gerdvilė; the user can copy the entry text for indexing.

negative_evidence: 16 November LV names Banga, Ganda, Jefimija, Landa, Landijs and Vētra and LT Gerdvilė and Vaišvydas have no local exact bearer with a national Wikipedia article. EE names (Arnold, Arno, Arne, Aarne) all already have five or more local bearers.
